item.title: Huge fire in Scotland triggers train chaos, partial collapse of historic building
item.description: By Laura Sharman, CNN (CNN) — A massive fire near one of Scotland’s busiest train stations has engulfed a historic building in Glasgow, causing it to partially collapse.
